# sonarqube_project_links (Resource)

A custom link shown on a project. SonarQube cannot edit links, so changes replace it. Import ID: `project_key/id`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "sonarqube_project_links" "docs" {
  project_key = "example-api"
  name        = "Documentation"
  url         = "https://docs.example.com/api"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Link name.
- `project_key` (String) Project key.
- `url` (String) Link URL.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Identifier of this resource in Terraform state.
- `type` (String) Link type reported by SonarQube.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import sonarqube_project_links.example 'example-api/AY1234567890abcdef'
```
